svg.title: Start where your customer works
svg.desc: Labels aligned to Esri documentation: Viewer and Contributor are user types for viewing or editing shared content, shown as everyday-work examples; GIS analysts and developers are personas named in Esri user-type guidance. GIS workflow owner and GIS administrator are inferred GIS personas for business processes and Azure infrastructure assessment, marked with an asterisk. These illustrative mappings are not licensing recommendations, technical architecture, or data flows. People may span several workflows.

g.text: Choose a familiar workflow, then ask what decision needs to improve.
* Inferred GIS persona. Labels are not license recommendations.
Conversation guide, not a technical architecture. Branches show choices, not data flows.
